'''2001 Michigan State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Garden City, Michigan on 28 April 2001. [[Joe Giannetti]] won it. It is known from Ed Rebman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2188">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-detroit-mi-4-28-01state-championshipsd2188/ detroit-mi-4-28-01state-championships], DeckTech (Ed "eddiehectic" Rebman, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-detroit-mi-4-28-01state-championshipsd2188/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Garden City, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Giannetti]]
